environment.scope: Shared runner; sequential cases; no exclusive CPU isolation. No RSS or p99 measurement.

rule.blockStatistic: mean of two candidate fork means / mean of two baseline fork means within the same ABBA block
rule.pointStatistic: arithmetic mean of the three paired-block ratios
rule.zeroAllocationBaseline: 0/0 is 1; positive candidate over zero baseline is null, zeroBaselineIncrease and targets-not-met.
rule.rangeScope: Observed three-block ratio range, not a confidence interval; iterations are not independent forks.
rule.use: Observed experiment targets, not a CI performance gate or production guarantee.
